issues.description: Stroke weight: the original strokes are noticeably heavier than the render's; the render's solid lines look thin relative to the figure size.
issues.suggestion: Increase line width from 1.0pt (e.g. to about 1.4-1.6pt) for the solid segments and the dashed MC if the thicker look should match the original.

issues.description: Label typeface: the original labels E and F (and the other letters) are rendered in a bold math italic, while the render uses a regular-weight math italic font.
issues.suggestion: If matching the original is required, set the label font to bold (e.g. \boldmath or \mathbf in the node text for E and F), keeping the same node anchors.
